question: Should the legacy `https://molt.bot/install.sh` installer remain a supported install path for this project?
rationale: The reported failure is concrete, but the failing hosted installer is not present in current ClawHub source, so automation cannot decide whether to repair, redirect, or retire it without maintainer ownership intent.

options.title: Retire or redirect legacy installer
options.body: Point users to the maintained `openclaw skills install` and `clawhub@latest install` flows and make the old hosted installer redirect or fail with current guidance.

options.title: Support and harden legacy installer
options.body: Make the hosted installer source traceable from this repository or an owned repo, reproduce the macOS/Homebrew zsh glob failure, and patch the cleanup function for unmatched paths.

options.title: Keep waiting for reporter data
options.body: Leave the issue waiting on author if maintainers cannot identify or control the hosted installer source yet.

recommendation.title: Retire or redirect legacy installer
recommendation.body: Point users to the maintained `openclaw skills install` and `clawhub@latest install` flows and make the old hosted installer redirect or fail with current guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest current-history owner for the maintained CLI/package install surface and Node/package guidance.
